text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa... gh.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that Chrono Genesis girl
sure has an incredible late kick!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Great run, everyone!
I'm already excited for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah...

Chrono Genesis returned to the waiting room,
looking not all that fatigued, which made me breathe a sigh of relief.
choice_data_list: That was a great run, Chrono!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Still...
the heat I felt on the turf was beyond anything I imagined."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It felt heavy and suffocating,
as if my skin was being scorched the entire time...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The voices of everyone shouting, "I want to win!" clash together... as if they are shaving away at their very lives—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I could barely manage to struggle
just to keep from being swallowed up...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I'm sure everyone who built our history felt that same fire in their hearts...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I will brace myself and train even harder
so that I may reach that level as well...!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's turn that lesson into fuel for growth!
Yeah. Let's take what we learned and build on it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

As we cleared out of the waiting room, Chrono Genesis's
parents, who had been eagerly waiting, rushed over with big smiles.

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Super! That was a wonderful run!
Great work out there."

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Father
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, it seems I got a bit overcome with emotion.
It happens all the time, so please don't pay it any mind.
choice_data_list: (Being quick to tears... she definitely takes after her mother.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono's Father
text_block_list.text:
"I got a wonderful shot of you running!
Here, take a look!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It just felt desperate...
Still a long way to go, huh...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Still...—
choice_data_list: That's a great photo—doesn't fall short of the senior Umamusume at all.
That's a wonderful photo, just as good as the senior Umamusume's.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! H-How did you know... N-No, it's nothing!
I shouldn't be so, so presumptuous...!
choice_data_list: (...You should just accept the facts as facts)

text_block_list.text:
Even legendary Umamusume weren't
perfect from the very start.
Everyone's first page in history is unrefined.
choice_data_list: That was a great run — you really left your mark in your own way.
That was a great run—you really left your own unique mark.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Mom, can I paste this photo into my binder?
The day after her debut race, I assessed her level of fatigue while considering our next move.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Fatigue shouldn't be an issue.
Fortunately, today is my day off, so—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I believe we can resume training
according to the original schedule.
choice_data_list: You've been running around that much, and you're still full of energy... Amazing.
You've been running around that much, and you're still full of energy... Amazing.

text_block_list.text:
After that, at Chrono Genesis's request,
we ended up staying to watch all the way through the final race.

She made countless trips back and forth between the paddock and the stands.
On top of that, there's the long journey back home.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-watching races has basically become
a daily routine for me, so...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I recalculated the win rate using the Genesis Method,
factoring in the results of my debut race.
choice_data_list: It pretty much ended up as expected, didn't it?
It pretty much ended up as expected, didn't it?

text_block_list.text:
"When I used the Genesis Method to predict
the race dynamics of the debut race, it played out exactly as predicted."

In other words, the Genesis Method has proven useful
for formulating future strategies and addressing weaknesses.
In that case, sticking with the original plan seems best.
choice_data_list: I'm thinking we should go for the Hanshin JF next.

text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin JF is a Junior-class GⅠ race
where Umamusume targeting the Tiara path gather.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. Just like that, please...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
That unique, tingling tension of a real race
that I felt back during my debut...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"To contend with that level of drive,
I must hone myself even further."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"That drive is at its absolute highest in a GⅠ... If so,
that's where—at the Hanshin JF—I want to fight...!"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's etch the glory of a G1 victory into your history!
Alright, let's etch the glory of a G1 victory into your history!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I'll do my best...!
